brief: We need a bracket that holds a 4 kg star tracker on a small satellite. It mounts to the side panel and the tracker sits 150 mm out from the panel. Launch is a rideshare; use 15 g quasi-static for design. The tracker needs a stiff mount: tip deflection under load must stay below 1.5 mm. It sits under a solar array hinge, so the plate can be at most 8 mm thick, and there is room for about 80 mm of width. The program uses factors of 1.25 on yield and 1.4 on ultimate.

reasoning: Governing loads: M = 588.6 N x 150 mm = 88,290 N-mm. Stress allowables are yield/1.25 and ultimate/1.4. Deflection is 4PL^3/(E b t^3). REQ-004 limits thickness to 3-8 mm, so the stock values 10, 12, 16, 20, 25 and 30 mm in REQ-005 are excluded. The degraded case (load x1.1, thickness minus 0.5 mm) is checked at t-0.5. Al 6061-T6 cannot meet the deflection limit with t<=8 mm and b<=80 mm. Ti-6Al-4V cannot meet it either, since at t=8 mm, b=80 mm the degraded stiffness term is 33,750 mm^4 against a required 51,212 mm^4. Steel 4130 at t=8 mm, b=68 mm (minimum width 67.4 mm for the degraded deflection) passes all checks, with degraded tip deflection about 1.49 mm, and is the lightest feasible candidate at about 0.64 kg for a 150 mm length. Stress is not limiting for steel.

notes.Al 6061-T6: Allowable is about 221 MPa (yield/1.25 = 220.8, ultimate/1.4 = 221.4), but deflection needs b*t^3 of about 8.5e4 mm^4 in the degraded case while t<=8 mm and b<=80 mm give at most 3.4e4 mm^4, so only confirm infeasibility at t=8 mm, b=80 mm and stop.
notes.Ti-6Al-4V: Allowable is about 679 MPa (ultimate-governed) and E=113.8 GPa, but the degraded deflection needs b*(t-0.5)^3 of about 5.1e4 mm^4, which exceeds the 3.4e4 mm^4 available at t=8 mm, b=80 mm, so only confirm infeasibility and stop.
notes.Steel 4130: Yield allowable is 348 MPa (yield/1.25) and E=205 GPa, so stress is not limiting; deflection is. Search t=8 mm only (t<=6 mm needs b>80 mm), with b from about 68 mm to 80 mm, minimizing b to reach the lowest mass near 0.64 kg.

text: I'll check the largest allowed section first, since it gives the best stiffness within the bounds.
I'll start by checking the lead's suggested 8 mm thickness at the low end of the width range, plus two wider options.

**Result: no Al 6061-T6 design in the allowed envelope meets all requirements.** I checked the bounding case, Al 6061-T6 at 80 mm × 8 mm, as the lead's note asked, and then stopped.

| Case | Thickness | Load | Yield MS | Ultimate MS | Tip deflection | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Nominal | 8 mm | 588.6 N | +1.13 | +1.14 | 2.82 mm | REQ-003 fails (limit 1.5 mm) |
| Worst case (REQ-006)

**No Ti-6Al-4V design can meet all requirements, so I am not proposing four passing designs.** The lead's note was correct.

**Verified result (Ti-6Al-4V, 80 mm × 8 mm, the largest section REQ-004 allows):**

| Check | Result | Requirement | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| REQ-001 yield MS | +5.80 | ≥ 0 at 1.25 | Pass |
| REQ-002 ultimate MS | +5.56 | ≥ 0 at 1.4 | Pass |
| REQ-003 tip deflection | 1.

The 68 mm, 8 mm design passes with margin, and the 70 and 75 mm widths pass too. Next I'll check whether 67 mm still passes, since REQ-006 is the binding constraint, and check 80 mm as the upper bound.

attacks.title: REQ-006 combined: load +10% and plate 0.5 mm thinner
attacks.rationale: Load 647.5 N with thickness 7.5 mm. Tool result: yield MS 1.284, ultimate MS 2.141, tip deflection 1.486 mm against the 1.5 mm limit. Passes, but with under 1% deflection margin, so the REQ-006 case is effectively at its limit.

attacks.title: Machining leaves plate 1.0 mm thinner (7 mm)
attacks.rationale: Deflection scales with 1/t^3, so a 1 mm thickness loss raises tip deflection to 1.662 mm, above the 1.5 mm limit. Strength margins remain positive (yield MS 1.189, ultimate MS 2.010). Stiffness is the first requirement to fail.

attacks.title: Layout change lengthens arm by 10 mm
attacks.rationale: Deflection scales with L^3, but the tool shows it still passes at 1.351 mm. Yield MS 1.680, ultimate MS 2.686. The arm length is a layout-sensitive input and should be frozen in the drawing.

attacks.title: Width loses 8 mm in machining (68 to 60 mm)
attacks.rationale: Lower second moment of area raises deflection to 1.262 mm, which passes. Yield MS 1.523, ultimate MS 2.469. Width loss matters less than thickness loss for stiffness but still reduces margin.

attacks.title: Launch load doubled (2.0x, about 30 g on 4 kg)
attacks.rationale: The 588.6 N design load already equals 15 g on 4 kg. A 2.0x shock is harsh but plausible. Strength margins stay positive (yield MS 0.429, ultimate MS 0.966), but tip deflection reaches 2.227 mm, well above the 1.5 mm limit. The design fails REQ-003 at about 1.35x load.

summary: The bracket passes all six structural and stability checks (S-01 to S-06) and the buy-to-fly and plate-availability checks (F-01 to F-03), but the material and procurement items M-01, M-04, M-05, X-01, X-02, P-01, P-02 and P-03 remain open as actions. Design allowables are still typical handbook values, and fatigue has not been analyzed, so the structural pass results cannot yet be treated as final.
top_risks: Design allowables are typical handbook values, not MMPDS A- or B-basis values (M-01), so the margins in S-01 to S-03 are not yet qualified.
Fatigue is not analyzed for launch vibration or other cyclic program loads (X-02), leaving a gap in the structural case beyond the static results.
Unprotected 4130 will rust, and dissimilar-metal joints risk galvanic corrosion (M-04, M-05), which could degrade the bracket in service if the finish and fastener specs are not set.

actions.action: Replace typical handbook values with MMPDS A- or B-basis allowables for AMS 6350 at this temper and the 8 mm thickness, then rerun margins S-01 to S-03.
Define cyclic program load cases such as launch vibration and perform the fatigue analysis.
Classify the part under the fracture control standard, for example non-fracture-critical, and record the rationale.
Specify plating or primer and paint for the 4130 bracket under the program finish spec.
Require a certificate of conformance and mill test report traceable to the heat lot in the purchase order.
